segments.name: consumer banking
segments.description: Offers everyday Americans FDIC-insured checking accounts, debit cards, early pay and fee-free overdraft through bank partners and a mobile app.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating segment and therefore, one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Card networks pay interchange fees when members use Chime-branded debit or credit cards; members pay fees for optional convenience products.
revenueModel.evidence: Payments revenue is based on interchange fees generated from purchase transactions made by members using their Chime-branded debit and credit cards.
